items.reason: Detail status menus use the same container-specific opener and entries as the row list.
Detail y opens the container’s Copy menu without copying immediately.
Detail m opens the Mute menu targeting the detail’s container.
Both surfaces dispatch I through the shared runFlatI helper.
View prioritizes drain-picker rendering while the detail remains open.
Direct y and p handling is removed from document peeks.
Direct p handling is removed from both detail lists.
Existing item and artifact r-menu handling remains intact, including peeks.
The shared status refusal is rendered through the detail frame’s fallback flash.
The shared copy refusal appears on the detail’s hint line.
The shared mute refusal appears on the detail’s hint line.
Container menus occupy Frame.Block, reducing the list’s available height.
Detail menus delegate navigation and invocation to the existing row-menu handlers.
Escape clears the container menu without clearing the detail.
Detail openers bypass Selection handling and create singular menus.
Slash starts detail search; Enter applies it and restores detail controls.
Shared matching implements case-insensitive substrings with terms AND-ed across id, title and type.
Item search fields exclude status.
Artifact search uses the shared grammar over filename and type.
Escape discards the editing buffer and reapplies the previous term.
Slash initializes an empty buffer; applying it restores all rows.
Search typing forwards printable keys to TextField before detail actions can handle them.
Detail synchronization reapplies the active query during refresh.
The detail header displays the applied search term.
Empty search results name the term and explain how to clear it.
Artifact availability depends on the complete artifact collection, preserving v after filtering.
Detail search state is separate from row search state and disappears with the detail.
Detail hints advertise r, s, y, m and slash without flat copy keys.
documentPeekChrome remains unchanged and still advertises y copy name and artifact p copy path.
Typing hints name only apply, cancel and help.
Detail help includes menus, the applicable I action, search and conditional clearing; peek help removes flat copies.
Typing has a dedicated help arm, but detail menus reuse row-menu help that incorrectly advertises disabled J/K navigation.

scores.rationale: Clear shared dispatch and search logic with substantial behavioral tests; unchanged peek hints and inaccurate detail-menu help remain uncovered.
